Pełzucki 1896 — the numbers' spot sheet working page

Each card is a place where the OCR read a number in the drawn portion of the map, with the machine's reading in the red box. The box is yours to adjust: drag inside it to move it, drag any edge to move that edge alone, a corner for both at once, so it frames exactly what is drawn (the machine's box is often too large or shifted — the adjusted box is saved with your answer and sharpens the site's position). Then correct or confirm the reading, Enter. Ctrl+Enter = cannot read; Ctrl+N = not a number; Esc skips. Answers persist in the browser; Export downloads the JSON at any point.

Drag inside the box to move it; drag any edge to move that edge alone, a corner for both at once — the cursor shows which. Hide box (H) shows the crop bare, no marks; the setting stays until you toggle it back. A blue box means you have adjusted it; Reset box puts it back where the machine had it.
